channel.title: NASA Space Exploration Updates
channel.description: Latest images and exploration updates tracked from nasa.gov

item.title: APOD: Supernova remnant Pa 30 with Gemini North
item.description: Gemini North image of Pa 30, the likely remnant of an old supernova, with filaments radiating outward like fireworks.

item.title: Webb: Star-forming region NGC 7129 in near-infrared (NIRCam)
item.description: Webb's NIRCam reveals protostars and stars within the glowing gas of NGC 7129.

item.title: Webb: Helix Nebula in near-infrared (NIRCam)
item.description: A portion of the Helix Nebula showing comet-like knots and layers of gas shed by a dying star.

item.title: Webb: Star cluster Westerlund 2 and its dwarf stars
item.description: Glowing gas clouds and thousands of stars in the cluster Westerlund 2.

item.title: Spitzer and Chandra: Tycho supernova remnant
item.description: Composite of infrared and X-ray observations of the expanding Tycho supernova remnant.

item.title: Hubble: Kepler supernova remnant
item.description: Hubble view of the bubble of gas left by Kepler's supernova.

item.title: Crab Nebula supernova remnant seen by five observatories
item.description: Composite of the Crab Nebula combining radio, infrared, visible, ultraviolet and X-ray data.

item.title: SMILE: complete auroral oval in ultraviolet
item.description: The SMILE spacecraft's first ultraviolet view shows an entire auroral oval around Earth's magnetic pole during a substorm.

item.title: Hubble: Dark rings and new light in a galaxy
item.description: Hubble Picture of the Month for January 2026 showing a galaxy with dark rings of dust and fresh starlight.

item.title: Webb: Spiral galaxy NGC 5134 in near- and mid-infrared
item.description: Two Webb instruments combine to show the stellar lifecycle in the nearby spiral galaxy NGC 5134.

item.title: Webb: Uranus upper atmosphere (January 2025)
item.description: Webb image of Uranus used to map the vertical structure of its upper atmosphere.

item.title: Webb: Galaxy cluster MACS J1149 and lensed galaxies
item.description: Webb view of the distant galaxy cluster MACS J1149.5+2223 with gravitationally lensed background galaxies.

item.title: Auroras over North America as seen from space
item.description: Satellite view of auroras over North America after the October 2012 coronal mass ejection.

item.title: IMAGE spacecraft view of Aurora Australis from space
item.description: NASA's IMAGE spacecraft observed the southern auroral oval from space in September 2005.

item.title: Suomi NPP: Aurora borealis over North America at night
item.description: The Suomi NPP satellite's day-night band captured the aurora borealis over North America.

item.title: APOD: M104 Sombrero Galaxy and its tidal streams
item.description: A deep image of the Sombrero galaxy reveals faint tidal streams around the galaxy.

item.title: Hubble: Starry spiral in a familiar neighbourhood
item.description: Hubble's picture of the month for April 2026 shows a spiral galaxy dotted with stars.

item.title: Hubble: Where spiral arms and star formation meet
item.description: A spiral galaxy imaged by Hubble showing star-forming regions along its arms.

item.title: Hubble and Webb: Two observatories, one cosmic eye
item.description: Hubble's picture of the month for March 2026 shows a galaxy with an eye-like appearance.

item.title: Webb: Young stars at every stage of formation in Orion
item.description: Webb image of a star-forming region in Orion showing young stars in various stages of formation.

item.title: Webb: Barred spiral galaxy Messier 77
item.description: Webb view of barred spiral galaxy M77 with swirling dust and a bright core.

item.title: Webb: Star-forming regions in M51
item.description: Webb image of star clusters forming in the spiral galaxy M51.

item.title: Hubble: Sombrero Galaxy (M104) in visible light
item.description: Hubble view of the Sombrero galaxy at the southern edge of the Virgo cluster.

item.title: Spitzer: Sombrero Galaxy (M104) in infrared
item.description: Spitzer infrared picture of the Sombrero galaxy showing its dusty ring.

item.title: Spitzer: Sombrero Galaxy as two galaxies in one
item.description: Spitzer infrared view showing the Sombrero galaxy as a disk embedded in a larger elliptical galaxy.

item.title: APOD: Supernumerary rainbows over New Jersey
item.description: A rainbow with extra faint inner arcs seen after the remnants of Hurricane Florence passed over the Jersey Shore in 2018.

item.title: APOD: Curiosity rover selfie at Vera Rubin Ridge, Mars
item.description: Selfie of the Curiosity rover on sol 1943 at the south rim of Vera Rubin Ridge on Mars.

item.title: Webb: Protostars in the FS Tau system (NIRCam)
item.description: Infrared view of bright protostars in the young FS Tau system with many background galaxies.

item.title: Webb and Hubble: Cigar Galaxy M82
item.description: Near-infrared view of the edge-on starburst galaxy Messier 82 combining Webb and Hubble data.

item.title: Webb and Hubble: Bulge fossil fragment Terzan 5
item.description: Dense stellar system Terzan 5 in the Milky Way's bulge, seen with Webb and Hubble.

item.title: Curiosity selfie on Vera Rubin Ridge, Mars (Mount Sharp behind)
item.description: Self-portrait of the Curiosity rover on Vera Rubin Ridge, taken January 2018.

item.title: Curiosity selfie at Rock Hall drill site, Vera Rubin Ridge
item.description: Curiosity selfie on sol 2291 at its 19th drill site, Rock Hall, on Vera Rubin Ridge.

item.title: Curiosity selfie at the Hutton drill site, Mars
item.description: Curiosity selfie from sol 2687 with the Greenheugh Pediment rock layer at the top of the frame.

item.title: Hubble: Starry chandelier
item.description: Hubble's Picture of the Month from June 2026, titled Starry chandelier.

item.title: Hubble: Journey to the centre of a galaxy cluster
item.description: Hubble view toward the centre of a galaxy cluster, its Picture of the Month for May 2026.

item.title: Webb: Treasure Chest star-forming region
item.description: Webb image of dust clouds in the Milky Way sculpted by starlight and stellar winds into a Treasure Chest shape.

item.title: Webb: Centaurus A in mid-infrared (MIRI)
item.description: Webb's MIRI shows the dusty structures and hidden activity of the nearby galaxy Centaurus A.

item.title: Webb: Galaxy cluster MACS J0553.4-3342 under construction
item.description: Webb Picture of the Month showing the merging galaxy cluster MACS J0553.4-3342.

item.title: APOD: Complete Sharpless Catalog of 313 H II regions
item.description: A mosaic showing all 313 nebulas of the Sharpless Catalog of H II regions.

item.title: Webb: IRS 3 field in near- and mid-infrared
item.description: Webb NIRCam and MIRI view of the IRS 3 field, a detailed mid-infrared look at a region hosting a highly evolved star.

item.title: Webb: Lion Nebula (NGC 2392) in near- and mid-infrared
item.description: Webb composite of planetary nebula NGC 2392, the Lion Nebula, showing its complex shells of gas.

item.title: GALEX: Andromeda Galaxy (M31) in ultraviolet
item.description: Galaxy Evolution Explorer observation of the Andromeda Galaxy, the most massive galaxy in the Local Group.

item.title: Artemis II: Christina Koch looks back at Earth from Orion
item.description: Astronaut Christina Koch looks out an Orion cabin window at Earth during the Artemis II mission.

item.title: Hubble: Eagle Nebula pillars of gas and dust
item.description: Dark pillars of cool hydrogen and dust in the Eagle Nebula (M16) where new stars form.

item.title: Hubble: Bow shock around a young star in Orion Nebula
item.description: Hubble view of a bow shock around a very young star in the Orion Nebula star-forming region.

item.title: Spitzer: Tarantula Nebula filaments and newborn stars
item.description: Infrared view of the Tarantula Nebula, a rich star-forming region with spidery filaments.

item.title: APOD: Harvest Moon rising over erupting Mount Etna
item.description: Composite photo of the full Moon rising over Sicily with the Belt of Venus and an erupting Mount Etna.

item.title: APOD: Peculiar spiral galaxy Arp 78 (NGC 772) in Aries
item.description: Amateur image of the 200,000 light-year wide spiral galaxy Arp 78, about 100 million light-years away.

item.title: APOD: Shrimp Nebula Sh2-188 planetary nebula
item.description: Sh2-188, one of the larger planetary nebulas in the night sky, with its swirling gas shaped by fast motion.

item.title: Hubble: A galaxy spinning out of sync
item.description: Hubble Picture of the Month showing a galaxy that rotates out of sync.

item.title: Hubble: Superbubble scene
item.description: Hubble Picture of the Month showing a superbubble region of stars and gas.

item.title: Hubble: One-sided spiral galaxy
item.description: Hubble Picture of the Month showing a spiral galaxy with arms mainly on one side.

item.title: Webb: Lensed galaxies in cluster MACS J0454.1-0300
item.description: Webb view of golden galaxies warped and multiplied by gravitational lensing in the cluster MACS J0454.1-0300.

item.title: Webb: Star-forming region IC 348 in near-infrared
item.description: Large NIRCam mosaic of IC 348, 1000 light-years away, showing brown dwarfs and young stars.

item.title: Webb: Star clusters and clumps in merger Arp 263
item.description: Infrared view of the irregular galaxy Arp 263 in Leo in the late phase of a galactic merger.

item.title: Webb: Cosmic Cliffs in the Carina Nebula (NGC 3324)
item.description: NIRCam infrared view of the edge of the young star-forming region NGC 3324 in the Carina Nebula.

item.title: Simulated supermassive black hole bending background starlight
item.description: Computer simulation of a supermassive black hole whose gravity smears the light of background stars.

item.title: Suomi NPP: Blue Marble view of Earth
item.description: Detailed Earth montage built from VIIRS observations on the Suomi NPP satellite.

item.title: Landsat 8: Twin plumes over Mount Etna
item.description: Landsat 8 natural-color view of ash and gas plumes rising from Mount Etna in October 2013.

item.title: Hubble: Ring Nebula planetary nebula
item.description: Hubble image of the Ring Nebula, a planetary nebula shed by a dying Sun-like star.
